record.official_rationale: Frente POLISARIO described the Sahrawi demonstrations as opposition to the Guerguerat road breach, Moroccan occupation and resource exploitation. This is the party’s stated position, not an independent finding or the established motivation of every demonstrator.
record.context: Moroccan military cleared blockade November 13; truck traffic resumed November 14. Sovereignty and actor descriptions are disputed.
record.uncertainty: Polisario’s contemporaneous position is now documented in a party statement circulated as a UN document. Attribution does not establish every protester’s affiliation or motivation. Moroccan descriptions are partisan; UN/MINURSO independently confirms civilian obstruction.
